name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-threews-3d-viewer
title: three.ws 3D viewer web part
shortDescription: SPFx web part that shows an interactive 3D model on a SharePoint page using the hosted three.ws viewer or the agent-3d web component.
longDescription: Page authors paste a GLB URL and choose a title, render mode and height in the property pane. The web part renders the model in the hosted three.ws viewer, or with the agent-3d web component loaded on demand. Includes a Teams tab manifest so the same web part works in Teams.

thumbnails.alt: SharePoint page showing the three.ws 3D viewer web part with a rendered 3D model

references.name: three.ws developer documentation
references.description: Public catalog, agents and viewer endpoints used by this sample.
